ph: wái-jooe-gan-mài ná khráp duu-lae-dtua-eeng-dûai
en: See you again, take care

cue: Nida says goodbye back to Somchai
speaker: B/female
text: ค่ะ เดินทางปลอดภัยนะคะ
ph: khâ doen-thaang-plàwt-phai ná khá
en: Yes, have a safe trip
